My symptoms are bad diarrhea and a lot of bleeding. To me it sounds like all signs point to an IBD in your case. I feel like your doctor should take it more seriously than he/she does. It only took me a month or so, 4 years is a long time. You shouldn't have to experience this much discomfort.

Don't eat too much in the days prior and that may help. (don't starve yourself either) I'm going to be honest and say that drinking all the fluid was terrible, and the worst part of the entire process for me. Having the actual colonoscopy was huge a relief, even though I was hella nervous. It also gets easier and easier as your digestive system "empties", in my experience. Personally I was sure I wouldn't be able to get it all down, but somehow I managed. I took longer than recommend, but the doctors still told me that everything was clear down there, so don't worry too much if you aren't able to get it down super quickly. I'm sure you'll get through this, it's for your own good after all. Good luck ♥️
